title: Demon Sniper
html:
Demon Sniper
Damage Type:  Piercing Damage
Wielding:  Two-Handed
Attack Speed:  Freakin' Fast

The Demon sniper is a pink skull bow that shoots dangerous arrows. The skin only appears in the Demon Sniper rainbow itself, so you wont find it in any other loot type. This weapon is considered as one of the best weapons for ranger, because of its speed and mana leech.

Attributes:

  • + Agility
  • + % Mana Steal
  • + % Melee Damage Reflection
  • + % Ranged Damage
  • + Shadow Damage per Second to Weapon Attack
